title: Judgment on Ephraim and Jerusalem

questions.question: Ah, the proud crown of the drunkards of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 28:1 (ESV): "Ah, the proud crown of the drunkards of Ephraim,"

questions.question: The proud crown of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under what?
In that day the LORD of hosts will be a crown of glory, and a diadem of beauty, to the remnant of his what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 28:5 (ESV): "to the remnant of his people,"

questions.question: For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept, line upon line, line upon what?
Here a little, there a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 28:10 (ESV): "here a little, there a little."

questions.question: Because you have said, "We have made a covenant with death, and with Sheol we have an what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 28:15 (ESV): "and with Sheol we have an agreement,"

questions.question: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD, "Behold, I am the one who has laid as a foundation in Zion, a stone, a tested stone, a precious what?"
And I will make justice the line, and righteousness the what?
And hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and waters will overwhelm the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 28:17 (ESV): "and waters will overwhelm the shelter."

questions.question: Then your covenant with death will be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol will not what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 28:18 (ESV): "agreement with Sheol will not stand;"

questions.question: For the bed is too short to stretch oneself on, and the covering too narrow to wrap oneself in it. For the LORD will rise up as on Mount what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 28:20-21 (ESV): "For the LORD will rise up as on Mount Perazim,"

questions.question: As in the Valley of Gibeon, to do his deed—strange is his deed! and to work his work—alien is his what?
Give ear, and hear my voice; give attention, and hear my what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 28:23 (ESV): "give attention, and hear my speech."

questions.question: Does he not scatter dill, sow cumin, and put wheat in rows and barley in its proper place, and emmer as the what?
For he is rightly instructed; his God teaches him. Dill is not threshed with a threshing sledge, nor is a cart wheel rolled over what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 28:27 (ESV): "nor is a cart wheel rolled over cumin,"

key_verse_text: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD, "Behold, I am the one who has laid as a foundation in Zion, a stone, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, of a sure foundation: 'Whoever believes will not be in haste.'"
